# Runwae Apparel: brand aesthetic

*Drafted 2026-10-12 for the Principal's taste call (his direction, verbatim: "Hopefully someone can come up with an
aesthetic to style ours and generate our photos"). Always **Runwae Apparel** in copy, never just "Runwae", which is the
separate app. Built from the brand's own 2021 material, not invented.*

## The idea: *Everybody Influences*
The 2021 magazine (*Runwae: "Everybody Influences", Issue No. 1*) put Runwae Apparel pieces inside gilt-framed
Renaissance and Baroque paintings. The idea: streetwear treated as a work of art, and art history wearing streetwear.
The aesthetic keeps that idea and makes it the house style.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| **Ground** | Charcoal `#1f1f1f` / panel `#272626`, like a gallery wall at night |
| **Accent** | Coral `#fa9674`, the magazine's rules and the tinted seal. One accent only |
| **Metal** | Gilt `#bca84a`, deep `#7f622d`, light `#e8d27a`. Frames and rules only, never type |
| **Type** | A serif display face (Cormorant/Garamond family) for names and the wordmark; quiet sans for body copy |
| **Marks** | The dripping-R seal (coral on charcoal); "Runwae Apparel" set in full; the hand-drawn RWA monogram only on The Little Things |
| **Voice** | Short, gallery-label calm. Name · line · medium. No hype, no fake scarcity |

## Two looks for product photos (pick one, or one per line)
Both are **LB's real mockups, cut out and composited exactly as drawn**. No design is generated or redrawn (playbook rule).
They're rendered by `storefront/tools/photos.py` (off-box, $0), 1080×1350, 4:5 for the shop and feed ads.

- **A · The Gallery:** the piece hung in a gilt frame on a spot-lit charcoal plaster wall, with a museum placard
  (name · *Runwae Apparel · line* · medium). It's the magazine, extended. Strongest on Fall '21's colour pieces.
- **B · The Sketchbook:** the piece laid flat on warm sketch paper with coral tape and a pencil caption. It's built
  from The Little Things' hand-drawn line. Quieter; strongest on the white-on-black TLT pieces.
- **Recommendation:** **A for Fall '21 + B for The Little Things.** The two drops get distinct worlds under one brand.

## What comes next (after the taste call)
- **On-model / lifestyle:** shoot the supplier samples (the playbook's sample run doubles as photos) in the same
  worlds, using poses from `design/photo_pose_inspiration/`. AI image generation stays limited to **backgrounds and
  sets**, never the garment or the print. It also needs an image-API key and spend, so it's gated.
- **Campaign:** "Everybody Influences, Issue No. 2", with the gallery shots as plates. That carries the brand's
  history forward into the drop's ads.
